notes: Complete principal Catherine Palace exterior: long blue/white/gold baroque body, returned north and south wings, three raised hall roofs and five projecting crowns, recessed multi-story windows, paired white pilasters, original simplified gilded trim, roof balustrades, supported main forecourt entry and five-domed palace chapel. Detached curved low forecourt ranges, Lyceum/connecting arch, Cameron gallery, garden pavilions and park stay native context. No interiors or copied statues,heraldry or inscriptions. Original medium-fi interpretation of individual roof transitions, facade/window inventories, gilded ornament and concealed joints. No copied artwork, statues or interior rooms; detached courtyard ranges and independent buildings are outside this principal-palace scope. Exact historic grades, survey accuracy, numerical LOD error and physical-device timings remain unmeasured. Native204 owned components are replaced; all182 independent components stay native.
